+# Export shell history function
+def export_shell_history(args)
+  # Parse command line options
+  options = {
+    output_file: nil,
+    format: nil,
+    unique: false,
+    dry_run: false,
+    verbose: false,
+    limit: nil,
+    include_timestamps: true
+  }
+
+  OptionParser.new do |opts|
+    opts.banner = "Usage: histlog export [format] [options] [output_file]"
+
+    opts.on("-f", "--file FILE", "Output file path (defaults to stdout)") do |file|
+      options[:output_file] = file
+    end
+
+    opts.on("-u", "--unique", "Export only unique commands (remove duplicates)") do
+      options[:unique] = true
+    end
+
+    opts.on("-n", "--dry-run", "Show what would be exported without writing") do
+      options[:dry_run] = true
+    end
+
+    opts.on("-v", "--verbose", "Show detailed export progress") do
+      options[:verbose] = true
+    end
+
+    opts.on("-l", "--limit COUNT", Integer, "Limit number of exported commands") do |limit|
+      options[:limit] = limit
+    end
+
+    opts.on("--no-timestamps", "Don't include timestamps (plain commands only)") do
+      options[:include_timestamps] = false
+    end
+
+    opts.on("-h", "--help", "Show this help") do
+      puts opts
+      exit 0
+    end
+  end.parse!(args)
+
+  # Get format and output file from positional arguments
+  if args.length > 0 && !args[0].start_with?('-')
+    options[:format] = args.shift.downcase
+  end
+
+  if args.length > 0 && !args[0].start_with?('-')
+    options[:output_file] ||= args.shift
+  end
+
+  # Determine format - priority: explicit format > auto-detect from filename > default
+  if options[:format].nil?
+    if options[:output_file] && options[:output_file] != '-'
+      options[:format] = detect_format_from_filename(options[:output_file])
+    else
+      options[:format] = 'plain'  # Default for stdout
+    end
+  end
+
+  # Validate format
+  unless ['fish', 'zsh', 'nu', 'nushell', 'plain'].include?(options[:format])
+    STDERR.puts "Error: Unsupported format '#{options[:format]}'"
+    STDERR.puts "Supported formats: fish, zsh, nu, plain"
+    exit 1
+  end
+
+  # Normalize nushell format name
+  options[:format] = 'nu' if options[:format] == 'nushell'
+
+  db_path = get_db_path
+  unless File.exist?(db_path)
+    STDERR.puts "No histlog.db found in current directory"
+    STDERR.puts "Use 'histlog init' to set up shell integration and start logging commands"
+    return
+  end
+
+  db = SQLite3::Database.new(db_path)
+  db.results_as_hash = true
+
+  # Build query to get commands with paths
+  if options[:format] == 'fish'
+    # For fish format, we need to get paths as well
+    query = "SELECT ct.command, c.start_time, c.id as command_id"
+    query += " FROM commands c"
+    query += " JOIN cmd_texts ct ON c.cmd_text_id = ct.id"
+    query += " WHERE c.cmd_text_id IS NOT NULL"
+  else
+    # For other formats, simple query without paths
+    query = "SELECT ct.command, c.start_time"
+    query += " FROM commands c"
+    query += " JOIN cmd_texts ct ON c.cmd_text_id = ct.id"
+    query += " WHERE c.cmd_text_id IS NOT NULL"
+  end
+
+  if options[:unique]
+    query += " GROUP BY ct.command"
+  end
+
+  query += " ORDER BY c.start_time DESC"
+
+  if options[:limit]
+    query += " LIMIT #{options[:limit]}"
+  end
+
+  puts "Exporting commands in #{options[:format]} format..." if options[:verbose]
+
+  begin
+    rows = db.execute(query)
+  rescue SQLite3::SQLException => e
+    STDERR.puts "Database error: #{e.message}"
+    exit 1
+  end
+
+  if rows.empty?
+    puts "No commands found to export"
+    return
+  end
+
+  puts "Found #{rows.length} commands to export" if options[:verbose]
+
+  # All shell formats (fish, zsh, nu) use chronological order (oldest first)
+  # We query DESC to get the most recent N commands, then reverse to chronological order
+  if ['fish', 'zsh', 'nu'].include?(options[:format])
+    rows = rows.reverse
+  end
+
+  # Format commands according to target shell format
+  formatted_commands = format_commands_for_shell(rows, options[:format], options)
+
+  if options[:dry_run]
+    puts "\nSample export output (first 10 entries):"
+    formatted_commands.first(10).each_with_index do |line, i|
+      puts "  #{i+1}. #{line}"
+    end
+    puts "..."
+    puts "\nTotal: #{formatted_commands.length} entries would be exported"
+    return
+  end
+
+  # Write to file or stdout
+  if options[:output_file] && options[:output_file] != '-'
+    File.open(options[:output_file], 'w') do |file|
+      formatted_commands.each { |line| file.puts line }
+    end
+    puts "Exported #{formatted_commands.length} commands to #{options[:output_file]}"
+  else
+    formatted_commands.each { |line| puts line }
+  end
+end
+
+# Detect output format from filename
+def detect_format_from_filename(filename)
+  case filename.downcase
+  when /fish_history/, /\.fish$/
+    'fish'
+  when /\.zsh_history$/, /\.zhistory$/, /\.zsh$/
+    'zsh'
+  when /nushell/, /\.nu$/, /history\.txt$/
+    'nu'
+  else
+    'plain'
+  end
+end
+
+# Format commands for specific shell format
+def format_commands_for_shell(rows, format, options)
+  formatted = []
+
+  case format
+  when 'fish'
+    rows.each do |row|
+      formatted << "- cmd: #{row['command']}"
+      if options[:include_timestamps] && row['start_time']
+        formatted << "  when: #{row['start_time'].to_i}"
+      end
+
+      # Add paths for fish format if command_id is available
+      if row['command_id']
+        paths = get_command_paths(row['command_id'])
+        if paths && !paths.empty?
+          formatted << "  paths:"
+          paths.each do |path|
+            formatted << "    - #{path}"
+          end
+        end
+      end
+    end
+
+  when 'zsh'
+    rows.each do |row|
+      if options[:include_timestamps] && row['start_time']
+        # Zsh extended history format: ": timestamp:0;command"
+        formatted << ": #{row['start_time'].to_i}:0;#{row['command']}"
+      else
+        # Simple format: just the command
+        formatted << row['command']
+      end
+    end
+
+  when 'nu'
+    # Nushell history is plain text, one command per line
+    rows.each do |row|
+      formatted << row['command']
+    end
+
+  when 'plain'
+    rows.each do |row|
+      if options[:include_timestamps] && row['start_time']
+        timestamp = Time.at(row['start_time'].to_f).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
+        formatted << "[#{timestamp}] #{row['command']}"
+      else
+        formatted << row['command']
+      end
+    end
+
+  else
+    # Fallback to plain format
+    rows.each do |row|
+      formatted << row['command']
+    end
+  end
+
+  formatted
+end
+
+# Get paths associated with a command
+def get_command_paths(command_id)
+  return [] unless command_id
+
+  db_path = get_db_path
+  return [] unless File.exist?(db_path)
+
+  db = SQLite3::Database.new(db_path)
+  db.results_as_hash = true
+
+  begin
+    # Get the command text to understand the command type
+    cmd_info = db.execute(
+      "SELECT ct.command, p1.path as old_path, p2.path as new_path FROM commands c
+       JOIN cmd_texts ct ON c.cmd_text_id = ct.id
+       LEFT JOIN paths p1 ON c.path_old_id = p1.id
+       LEFT JOIN paths p2 ON c.path_new_id = p2.id
+       WHERE c.id = ?",
+      [command_id]
+    ).first
+
+    return [] unless cmd_info
+
+    command_text = cmd_info['command']
+    old_path = cmd_info['old_path']
+    new_path = cmd_info['new_path']
+
+    # Get paths from path_args table with type information
+    path_args = db.execute(<<-SQL, [command_id])
+      SELECT pa.arg_position, p.path, p.type
+      FROM path_args pa
+      JOIN paths p ON pa.path_id = p.id
+      WHERE pa.command_id = ?
+      ORDER BY pa.arg_position
+    SQL
+
+    paths = []
+
+    # Special handling for cd commands
+    if command_text.strip.match(/^cd\s/)
+      # For cd commands, extract the literal argument from the command text
+      # Handle compound commands by only taking the first argument to cd
+      cd_match = command_text.strip.match(/^cd(?:\s+([^\s;&|]+))?/)
+      if cd_match && cd_match[1]
+        cd_arg = cd_match[1].strip
+        # Remove quotes if present
+        cd_arg = cd_arg.gsub(/^['"]|['"]$/, '')
+        paths << cd_arg
+      end
+      # If cd with no arguments (cd to home), don't add any paths
+    else
+      # For non-cd commands, include actual file/directory arguments only
+      # Do NOT include working directories
+      seen_paths = Set.new
+
+      path_args.each do |row|
+        path = row['path']
+        unless seen_paths.include?(path)
+          paths << path
+          seen_paths.add(path)
+        end
+      end
+
+      # Do not add old_path or new_path (working directories) for non-cd commands
+    end
+
+    paths
+  rescue SQLite3::SQLException => e
+    []
+  ensure
+    db&.close
+  end
+end
